name: Tornado Damage Classification Dataset
description: A labeled imagery dataset and benchmark for automated classification of levels of structural damage caused by tornadoes to accelerate disaster response.
reputation: Moderately used in disaster-response and remote-sensing research but less widely adopted than larger public satellite/image benchmarks.
notes: Likely subject to class imbalance, geographic/sensor bias and relatively small sample sizes; non-LLM benchmark focused on computer-vision models.
